metadata.title: Barnängshuset – A World Away From The Noise
metadata.description: Creative office building in Södermalm, Stockholm. Calm workspace with nature proximity and curated access to the best local culture.

sections.headline:
Space that works
around you.
sections.intro: Barnängshuset is a creative office building in Södermalm—where a century of industrial character meets workspace designed for the way people actually think and make.

sections.headline: We believe great work happens when the space around you disappears.
sections.body: Every decision at Barnängshuset—from ceiling height to coffee quality—starts with a single question: does this help people focus, connect, and do their best work?

sections.headline: A century of character. A workspace for today.
sections.body: Originally a textile mill built in 1899, Barnängshuset has been carefully restored rather than erased. The massive timber beams are still here. So are the dramatic windows and soaring ceilings. What we've added is everything that makes a modern workspace function: fast infrastructure, flexible floor plans, and a community of people worth being around.
sections.pullQuote: Distance from the centre creates better boundaries. Proximity to nature improves how we think.

image.alt: Interior detail — industrial ceiling beams and natural light

sections.headline: Built on three principles
sections.intro: Character, proximity, and community. These are the things we will never compromise.

amenities.name: Character over novelty
amenities.description: We preserved the original industrial architecture not out of nostalgia, but because authenticity creates an atmosphere that no amount of interior design can replicate. When a space has real history, it gives tenants a story worth telling.

amenities.name: Distance as a feature
amenities.description: Eight minutes from Slussen. Close enough to reach the city; far enough to leave it behind. The surrounding parks and neighbourhood culture aren't extras—they are part of what makes Barnängshuset work as a place to think.

amenities.name: A community worth joining
amenities.description: We are selective about our tenants—not by size or sector, but by temperament. The people who work here are makers, founders, and thinkers who take their work seriously and their neighbours seriously too.

items.quote: We looked at twelve buildings before Barnängshuset. The others felt like serviced offices pretending to be something else. This place actually has a soul—and the people here push us to do better work.
items.author: Maja Lindqvist

items.quote: The surrounding neighbourhood is half the reason we chose this building. Our team walks to Vitabergsparken after lunch, grabs coffee at a different place every week. That kind of environment doesn't show up in the floor plan, but it matters enormously.
items.author: Jonas Eriksson

sections.headline: From first conversation to moving in.
sections.intro: We keep the leasing process simple. No agents, no hidden costs—just a direct conversation about what your team needs.

steps.title: Enquire
steps.body: Tell us about your team—size, rhythm, and what you're looking for. We'll share what's available and what's coming up. No pressure, no pitch.

steps.title: Visit
steps.body: Come and see the building on your own terms. We'll walk the floor together, talk through fit-out options, and answer every question you have about the community.

steps.title: Move in
steps.body: Flexible lease terms, transparent pricing, and a move-in process designed to get your team settled quickly. From signed lease to first day at your desk in weeks, not months.

sections.headline: Eight minutes from everything
sections.intro: Vitabergsparken for afternoon walks. SoFo for coffee and culture. Everything within reach.

spots.name: Vitabergsparken
spots.description: Stockholm's most beloved park. Open meadows, forest trails, and a view over the city from the top.

spots.name: Café SoFo
spots.description: Best morning coffee in the neighbourhood. Homemade pastries and a calm corner seat.

spots.name: Bistro Nora
spots.description: French-inspired bistro. Perfect for team lunches or Friday aperitivos.

spots.name: Vintage & Ink
spots.description: Curated vintage furniture and design objects. A treasure hunt for the office.

spots.name: Kultur Bar
spots.description: Live music every Thursday. Craft cocktails and a scene. Where Södermalm comes to gather.

spots.name: Søgaard Gallery
spots.description: Rotating exhibitions. Emerging Nordic artists. A reason to step away from the desk.

sections.headline: Let's talk
sections.intro: Whether you're looking for office space, want to book a conference room, or just curious—we'd love to hear from you.
